rule: This file fixes the scope, the denominators and the weights. It was written before any score was computed. A score may not be improved by dropping a blocked source, removing a difficult year, shrinking the expected universe, counting an unvalidated download as complete, or reweighting after seeing a result. A blocked item stays in the denominator as a visible gap.

instrumentUniverse.note: today's registered universe; delisted names that were never seeded are out of scope and recorded as a survivorship limitation, not removed from the denominator of anything they would affect

1_dataCoverage.statement: validated observations divided by expected eligible observations in the frozen scope
1_dataCoverage.priceDenominator: sessions inside each asset's own first-to-last stored range on its market's calendar; a listing or delisting date is never counted as missing; exchange holidays and no-trade sessions are classified separately and excluded from the numerator AND the denominator only when the classification is evidenced
1_dataCoverage.documentDenominator: the predefined target counts above, never file sizes
1_dataCoverage.blockedHandling: a SOURCE_BLOCKED or LICENSE_BLOCKED target stays in the denominator at zero numerator

2_organisationAndValidation.statement: required inventory items carrying ALL SIX attributes, divided by all required inventory items
2_organisationAndValidation.denominator: all 18 layers in source_inventory.json, including the blocked ones

3_trainingReadiness.statement: eligible asset-sessions carrying validated point-in-time features in the versioned training dataset, divided by all eligible asset-sessions
3_trainingReadiness.mustAlsoReport: contextLayerIntegration = layers joined into examples-v3 / 18, reported separately and never substituted for this metric

mandatoryGates: no future return, future event or unpublished macro value in any predictor feature
macro publication lag respected wherever macro is used
corporate actions, listing dates, asset classes, currencies and bad-bar flags correct
crypto and commodities not grouped under US in any evaluator or report
overlapping 20-session outcomes not treated as independent; chronological split with a 20-session embargo
every evaluation reproducible from a versioned artifact and a recorded configuration
coverage, data quality, directional accuracy and execution readiness reported separately; unknown transaction costs never reported as zero

decisionRule.appliesTo: the weighted overall score of metrics 1 and 2 across the eight domains
decisionRule.ifBelow: report the real number and the precise blockers; state separately whether the V1 price/volume baseline is independently safe to evaluate, and never present one as the other
